instructor: Prof. Dr. Abdul Hadi Mohammed Adkhil
subject: 05_Soft_Computing

questions.question: How is the union of two fuzzy sets computed?
questions.explanation: Union takes the maximum of the two membership grades at each element.
questions.explanation_ar: الاتحاد يأخذ أقصى درجتي الانتماء عند كل عنصر.

questions.question: Which rule computes the intersection?
questions.explanation: Intersection takes the minimum of the two grades at each element.
questions.explanation_ar: التقاطع يأخذ أدنى الدرجتين عند كل عنصر.

questions.question: How is the complement of a fuzzy set computed?
questions.explanation: Complement subtracts each grade from one, so 0.1 becomes 0.9.
questions.explanation_ar: المتمم يطرح كل درجة من واحد، فتصبح 0.1 هي 0.9.

questions.question: Why is the complement a unary operation?
questions.explanation: A unary operation acts on one set, unlike union and intersection.
questions.explanation_ar: العملية الأحادية تعمل على مجموعة واحدة، بخلاف الاتحاد والتقاطع.

questions.question: On a graph, what is the union of two fuzzy sets?
questions.question_ar: على الرسم، ما هو اتحاد مجموعتين ضبابيتين؟
questions.explanation: The union is the upper envelope of the two membership curves.
questions.explanation_ar: الاتحاد هو الغلاف العلوي لمنحنيي الانتماء.

questions.question: In fuzzy set theory, which logical operation does union correspond to?
questions.question_ar: في نظرية المجموعات الضبابية، أي عملية منطقية يقابلها الاتحاد؟
questions.explanation: Union takes the maximum, which is the fuzzy counterpart of logical OR.
questions.explanation_ar: الاتحاد يأخذ الأعلى، وهو النظير الضبابي لعملية OR المنطقية.

questions.question: How is the intersection of two fuzzy sets computed at each point?
questions.question_ar: كيف يُحسب تقاطع مجموعتين ضبابيتين عند كل نقطة؟
options: the smaller of the two grades
the larger of the two grades
the product of the two grades
options_en: the smaller of the two grades
the larger of the two grades
the product of the two grades
questions.explanation: Intersection takes the minimum of the two membership grades at every element.
questions.explanation_ar: التقاطع يأخذ أدنى درجتي العضوية عند كل عنصر.

questions.question: What does the complement of a fuzzy set represent?
options: the union of the two sets
the intersection of the two sets
options_en: the union of the two sets
the intersection of the two sets
questions.explanation: The complement negates the concept, so a high grade for A becomes a low grade for not A.
questions.explanation_ar: المتمّم ينفي المفهوم، فدرجة عالية لـ A تصبح درجة منخفضة لـ ليس A.
